---
name: Incident Report
about: Standard incident report format
title: ''
labels: 'bug'
assignees: ''
---

**Type of Issue:**
The category, e.g. physics logic, low-quality 3D rendering, data/catalog pipeline, etc
**Affected Files:**
The files involved, including paths.
**Affected profiles:**
Only the affected profiles. Write "all" if every profile is affected, or "n/a" if none are.
**Description of Issue:**
What happens, what was expected, and how the issue was noticed.
**Potential Reasons for Issue:**
Best guesses for reasons clearly documented as guesses. This includes dead ends.
**Potential Solutions:**
Possible solutions to issue, may be in detail.
